```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS home_win_rate
FROM main."Match" m
JOIN main."League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND CAST(m.date AS DATE) >= DATE '2015-08-01'
  AND CAST(m.date AS DATE) <= DATE '2016-05-25';
```
